description: Java source file defining Cucumber step definitions for inline Close of Business (COB) operations related to loans in the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods for executing the COB job and verifying the creation of various business events such as repayment due, overdue, and custom snapshot events.

classes.name: InlineCOBStepDef
classes.description: Cucumber step definitions for executing inline COB operations and verifying related events for loans.

methods.name: runInlineCOB
methods.description: Triggers execution of the inline COB job for a specific loan by calling the InlineJobApi and verifies the API call success.

methods.name: checkLoanRepaymentDueBusinessEventCreated
methods.description: Asserts that a LoanRepaymentDueEvent has been raised for the loan.

methods.name: checkLoanRepaymentOverdueBusinessEventCreated
methods.description: Asserts that a LoanRepaymentOverdueEvent has been raised for the loan.

methods.name: checkLoanRepaymentDueBusinessEventCreatedWithBusinessDate
methods.description: Checks that a LoanAccountCustomSnapshotEvent has been raised with the expected business date.
